pair_decision: Final pilot pair 12/12. Both independently rebuilt patches pass the frozen YAML/security criteria, exact one-file scope, offline wheel build/install, and all 58 project tests. Candidate code/test/security reviews passed in the workflows required for each condition. v2 has a recorded process deviation for two read-only pip diagnostics run without the required offline variables; no index access was reported. The actual GitHub workflow was not dispatched.
